HTOS Visual User Guide — Orders & Simplified Invoice Check

Clear, step-by-step instructions covering Order History, the simplified 3-step Invoice Check, every status badge, and supplier credit follow-up.

Quick 3-Step Invoice Check Overview

  1. Step 1 — Invoice details & totals: Verify the invoice number, date, and totals (Net, Charges/discounts, VAT, Total gross) against the original invoice.
  2. Step 2 — Check items: Review the clean 5-column table (Item · Ordered · Invoice / Delivered · Issue / Status · Mark) and click Done or Follow on each line.
  3. Step 3 — Confirm & finish: Tick the 2 short sign-off boxes, then click Approve invoice (when settled) or Prepare claim → (when the supplier owes stock or credit).

Part 1 — Order History

  1. Use the top filters (Branch, Supplier, Delivery status, Email status, or Search) to locate an order quickly.
  2. Click any order card to inspect ordered items, branch delivery notes, and supplier email history.
  3. If a supplier did not receive the order email, click Resend order email on the order card.

Part 2 — Opening an Invoice (Accounts Inbox)

  1. Open Check invoices from the left navigation sidebar.
  2. Filter by Branch, Supplier, Status, or type into Search (invoice number, order ref, branch, or supplier).
  3. Click Review on any invoice row to open the guided 3-step check.
Inbox StatusWhat It MeansWhat To Do

Part 3 — Step 1: Invoice Details & Progress Bar

Using the 3-Step Progress Bar

  • 1. Invoice details — turns green once the invoice number, date, and Net / VAT / Gross totals match.
  • 2. Check items — turns green once every line item and scan check is resolved.
  • 3. Confirm & finish — turns green once both verification checkboxes are ticked.
  • Look at the single Next: line underneath the 3 steps: click Open scan review → to jump straight to any unit/scan check, or click Checklist (N) to expand every remaining item.

Completing Step 1 (Invoice details & totals)

  1. Verify Invoice number, Invoice date, and Invoice file (tip: click Fill from AI draft to fill them automatically from the scanned invoice).
  2. Verify Net (£), Charges / discounts (£), VAT (£), and Total gross (£).
  3. Check the summary strip underneath: if a delivery fee or surcharge creates a small difference, click Add £XX.XX to charges to balance it in one click.
  4. If AI scan & unit review (N to confirm) shows a number, open it to confirm any unclear pack/unit readings. Click Add another invoice scan only if you need to attach another page.

Viewing the Original Invoice Side-by-Side

Tip: Keep View invoice open while checking prices and totals so you never have to switch browser tabs. Use Copy ref to copy the invoice number or Hide invoice to return to full width.

Part 4 — Step 2: Check Items (5-Column Table)

The 5 Clean Columns

  1. Item — HTOS product name & code (any different supplier invoice wording appears neatly underneath in blue).
  2. Ordered — Quantity, unit, and expected unit price from the original HTOS order.
  3. Invoice / Delivered — Billed quantity and unit price from the invoice, plus a red Delivered: pill when branch staff received fewer units.
  4. Issue / Status — Automatic status badge (or dropdown if you need to override the reason).
  5. Mark — Choose Done (checked / acceptable) or Follow (keep open for claim or follow-up).
Quick Helpers Above the Table: Switch to Needs attention (N) to hide matched lines · Click Mark N wording-only Done to clear harmless spelling/bilingual name differences in one click · Tick Edit qty / price if you need to correct a misread invoice figure.
Colour & Issue StatusWhat It MeansHow To Solve It
AI matched / MatchedOrdered, delivered, and invoiced quantity & price match.Already marked Done — skip it.
ID / NameQuantity & price match, only supplier code or wording differs.Verify it is the same product and click Done (or click Mark N wording-only Done).
Price (+£X.XX / -£X.XX)Supplier billed a different unit price than expected.Check the PDF. Leave on Follow to claim an overcharge, or click Done if the price update was agreed.
Unit / Pack (Packet vs Box)Supplier billed in Packets/Each while HTOS ordered in Boxes/Cases, or unit was unclear.Check the multiplied line total (see example below). If total matches, confirm in AI scan & unit review and click Done.
Missing (N)Branch received fewer units than the supplier charged.Keep on Follow so the shortage goes into Prepare claim → (or link a replacement).
Damage (N)Damaged goods were rejected at delivery.Keep on Follow to claim credit or confirm replacement stock.
Not on order (Extra)Invoice includes a line that was not on the original order.Match it to a supplier item or click Leave unmatched in the purple block below.

Understanding Box vs Packet (Unit Conversion Example)

Part 5 — Extra Items & Step 3: Confirm & Finish

Handling Extra Items on Invoice (Purple Block)

  • Known supplier item? Select it in Match supplier item... and click Done if approved.
  • Unauthorised or billed by mistake? Click Leave unmatched and leave Follow selected so Accounts can dispute it.
  • Approved delivery/packaging charge? Add it via Add £XX.XX to charges in Step 1 and mark Done.

Completing Step 3 (Confirm & finish)

  1. Tick both short sign-off boxes once totals and items are checked:
    • Supplier, items, quantities and units match the invoice.
    • Net, charges/discounts, VAT and gross match the invoice total.
  2. (Optional) Click + Add Accounts note (optional) to record any internal explanation.
  3. Choose your action:
    • Save draft — saves all changes without approving yet.
    • Hold — pauses the invoice while waiting for missing information.
    • Prepare claim (£XX.XX) → — opens Credits & Replacements to email a supplier claim or log a replacement.
    • Approve invoice — final sign-off once all checks in Steps 1–3 are green.

Part 6 — Credits & Replacements Tab

  1. Replacements & Later Deliveries: Click Add later delivery (or confirm a branch-reported replacement) and link replacement stock to the exact missing/damaged item.
  2. Claim & Credit Note Follow-up: Prepare and email the supplier claim for remaining open items. When the credit note arrives, upload it here and allocate it until the open balance reaches £0.00.

Part 7 — Summary & History Tab

Use Summary & History to check at a glance how much was claimed, how much has been resolved by credit notes or replacements, what balance remains open, and the full chronological audit trail.

Quick Troubleshooting — Why Is "Approve invoice" Still Greyed Out?

Check the 3-step progress bar and the single Next: prompt at the top of the page (or click Checklist (N) to list every remaining item):

Message in Next: / ChecklistHow To Clear It Quickly
Enter invoice number / dateFill in Invoice number and Invoice date in Step 1 (or click Fill from AI draft).
Net / VAT / Gross mismatch (£XX.XX difference)Check Net, Charges/discounts, VAT, and Total gross in Step 1, or click Add £XX.XX to charges for a delivery/packaging fee.
Confirm units and price basis for N invoice rowsClick Open scan review → in the top bar and confirm the unit/pack reading for each flagged row.
Items still need review / extra rows unmatchedIn Step 2, click Needs attention, click Mark N wording-only Done for spelling differences, mark valid rows Done, and resolve every purple extra item.
Later delivery awaiting Accounts confirmationOpen Credits & Replacements and confirm or reject any pending branch replacement report.
Tick 2 sign-off boxesScroll to 3. Confirm & finish and tick both confirmation checkboxes.
